summary: Read-only ponytail audit of narduk-maps and narduk-charts. 4 must, 12 should, 2 nice. Candle buckets overlap, aggregated volume is scaled to one raw bar, and a controlled candle domain resets when bars append. Histogram NaN throws. One NaN poisons SMA. The SVG map is sound for clean regional GeoJSON; the GL wrapper drops keyboard shapes, print labels, a later mark radius, and the poster after WebGL context loss.
